codeReview.summary: Pass. I reviewed the original failed feature commit `ea1b1f5cac6981daad4c376395bde52abb67692c` together with the fix commit `bedc82780661ccdacff53c9e45c2dab1d56791f6`. The original blocker is resolved: the keychainless broker-seed path now asks for env-backed Hack auth session state first, explicitly disables stored broker-auth fallback for that path, and returns `hack auth login` guidance instead of reading the selected profile secret envelope or generic stored Hack auth session. The updated regressions in `tests/linear-auth.test.ts` and `tests/linear-commands.test.ts` directly cover both the no-local-read success case and the fail-closed no-broker-auth case.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared environment library still does not document the env-backed Hack auth session variables that now power deterministic keychainless broker-auth verification for Linear. Future workers will likely need to rediscover `HACK_AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN` / `HACK_AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRES_AT` by grepping the codebase.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/environment.md:16-27 lists broker/runtime env inputs but omits `HACK_AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN` and `HACK_AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRES_AT`; the new fix depends on them in `src/control-plane/extensions/linear/auth.ts:13-14,705-726,832-846`; and `worker-transcripts.jsonl:62` shows the fix worker repeatedly grepping for `HACK_AUTH_.*TOKEN`, `loadHackAuthSession`, and management-token paths before landing on the verification hook.

sharedStateObservations.observation: There is still no declared reusable service/command entry for the env-backed broker-auth Linear smoke that this kind of keychainless review now needs, so workers fall back to one-off inline commands.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/services.yaml:1-25 defines `linear_status` and `repo_linear_smoke` but no env-backed broker-auth variant; the fix handoff's verification used an ad hoc `HACK_AUTH_SESSION_TOKEN=... ./dist/hack linear status --json` command plus a separate `bun -e` mint helper to prove the non-keychain broker-seed path.

summary: Pass. The fix addresses the original blocking issue from `linear-keychainless-credential-path`: broker seeding for the keychainless repo-bound path now succeeds only when broker auth is already available through env-backed Hack auth session state and otherwise fails closed with explicit `hack auth login` guidance before any stored local secret reads.
